verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a workflow-automation platform like Make, but nothing in the evidence shows the core product can be self-hosted. Every item describes cloud-hosted APIs, the MCP server and webhooks. The on-prem agents API endpoint (make-docs-39) only lists agents for a company; it does not show deploying the Make platform on your own infrastructure, so it is at most an adjacent feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
